data.body_html:
Combine two of Marbella’s best water activities into one unforgettable day: a jet ski and snorkel combo experience departing from Puerto Banús. Ride a speedboat along the coast, dive into crystal-clear coves, and sip chilled cava as the sun warms the deck. This private charter is ideal for couples, small groups, or families who want variety without compromising on comfort. With a licensed skipper, all drinks, and snorkelling gear included, you just show up and enjoy.

Why choose a jet ski and snorkel combo in Marbella?

Marbella’s coastline offers sheltered coves, calm waters, and year-round sunshine — perfect conditions for both jet skiing and snorkelling. A combo charter lets you switch between adrenaline and relaxation in a single trip. You’ll cover more ground than a standard boat tour, reaching spots like Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés, where the water visibility often exceeds 10 metres. Plus, with drinks and snacks included, you can stay out longer without worrying about logistics. It’s a practical way to experience the Costa del Sol’s marine highlights without hiring multiple operators.

What’s included in your charter

  • Licensed skipper (English and Spanish speaking)
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Snorkelling masks and fins
  • Unlimited water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, nuts, fruit)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • 21% Spanish IVA

You can also bring your own food or request a catering upgrade via WhatsApp. The skipper handles all navigation, so you can focus on the fun.

Recommended boats for this experience

For small groups, the Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) are ideal — both priced from €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. If you have a larger party, consider the Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) at €4,719 for a minimum 4 hours, which includes a free jet ski. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, Marbella’s most famous marina.

Browse our full fleet on the Boat Rental Marbella page for more options.

Typical itinerary for a 4-hour combo

A common route starts at Puerto Banús, heading east past the Golden Mile and Marbella Marina. After 20 minutes, you’ll reach Cala del Faro, where the water is calm and clear. Here, you’ll drop anchor for 30–45 minutes of snorkelling. Then, you can take the speedboat for a 15-minute ride along the coast, passing La Concha mountain in the background. A second stop at Cala Cortés offers more snorkelling or a swim. On the way back, the skipper will serve drinks and snacks as you cruise past the luxury villas of the Golden Mile.

Best time of year for jet skiing and snorkelling

The water temperature in Marbella ranges from 14°C in winter to 24°C in August. For the best snorkelling visibility (often 10–15 metres), aim for May through October. Summer months (June–September) offer warm air temperatures of 28–32°C and calm seas. Spring and autumn are also good, with fewer crowds and lower prices. Winter trips are possible but require a wetsuit — we can arrange one on request.

How to book your jet ski and snorkel combo

Booking is straightforward. Contact us via WhatsApp or use the form on our website. Tell us your preferred date, group size, and duration (2h, 4h, 6h, or 8h). We’ll confirm availability and send a secure payment link. For Tier A boats, the price is fixed at €749/2h or €2,299/8h. For larger yachts like the Mangusta 80, pricing is on request. All charters include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, and VAT.
